card.name: Words before a finger or object touching
card.fires_on: Small words such as a, your, under or body that come right before the thing used to touch, tap or press a surface. Typical settings are tapping a syringe with your finger and placing a penny under paper for a rubbing.

modes.label: Tap with your finger
modes.description: The word your after gently tap the syringe or vial with, in injection instructions.
modes.example: If there are bubbles, gently tap the syringe with<< your>> finger until the bubbles rise to the top

modes.label: Object placed under paper
modes.description: Words in the idea of putting a penny or leaf under paper for a rubbing.
modes.example: Of course, I was familiar with the idea of putting<< a>> penny or leaf under a paper and running

modes.label: Body part touching a ball
modes.description: Words before a body part used to touch or contact something.
modes.example: goalkeepers may touch the ball with any part of their<< body>> while in their own penalty area

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about elastic material, edges and margins, with little other clear effect.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the thing that touches or taps a surface, like your finger on a syringe.
